scope: Stage C Phase 1B continuation using the identity-adjudicated StageB_V20_20261103 registry; quantitative ordinary-food evidence and mappings only. Stage A and Phase1-v1.3.0 are read-only dependencies.

validation.new_full_regression_tests: not run in this checkpoint build

limitations: Thirteen identity-pending compounds remain; no numerical coverage was assigned to them.
Phase1-v1.3.0 and the StageB_FINALIZED working tree were not updated to this V20 successor.
No cooking retention, population dietary exposure, bioavailability, clinical outcome or health-risk conclusions are included.
Batch 115 NHDC value is a category mean with LOQ/2 substitution for two below-LOQ detections; it is not sample-specific.

Batch 116 Irilone value (0.06 mg/g dry weight) is a literature-level leaf summary; its number is transcribed from a cited pharmacopoeial monograph because the primary numerical table was not directly accessible.
Batch 117 ginkgolic acid C13:0 value is measured in dried Ginkgo leaf tea product and must not be interpreted as brewed-infusion concentration.
The 130 minimum remains six short; this is a validated progress checkpoint, not target-complete closeout.
Six identity-complete compounds remain without accepted ordinary-food quantitative data.
Batch 117 Ginkgo measurement is dried tea product, not brewed infusion.
Batch 118 Eupatorin measurement is for composite dried A. vulgaris aerial parts; culinary use is documented separately and the result is not a prepared-food or leaf-only concentration.
Batch 119 reviewed the then-current seven remaining identity-complete gaps and accepted no new compounds; Batch 120 subsequently added one, leaving six.
Batch 120 amentoflavone result is from one experimental Maazoun melon-seed oil sample; triplicate analytical determinations do not describe biological or market variability.

Batch 121 held a secondary-reported Maazoun melon-seed value for “naringenin-7-O-glycoside”: accessible evidence did not establish the exact Prunin sugar/linkage or verify the primary calibration standard, so it was not counted.
verification: Run python3 verify_release.py and python3 stageC/scripts/validate_phase1.py from the package root.
